concept.name: Constraint
concept.definition: A condition that restricts the feasible parameters, predictions, portfolio weights, or decisions available to an optimization.
concept.intuition: It is a learnable mapping or representation used to turn features into predictions or groups.
concept.mechanics: Express the restriction as bounds, equalities, inequalities, or admissible sets and search only solutions that satisfy them.
concept.failure_modes: Flexible models can fit noise, shift under new regimes, and conceal instability when tuning is repeated on the same validation data.
concept.misconceptions: Greater model complexity or in-sample accuracy does not by itself imply better out-of-sample trading results.
concept.example: A portfolio optimizer requires every weight between 0% and 5% and all weights to sum to 100%.

citations.source: CFA Institute Research Foundation, Investment Model Validation
